description: Production code: make dependencies explicit through constructor injection. Pass all external dependencies as constructor parameters. No hidden global state. Tests easily inject test doubles. Example: Agent(config_loader=loader, domain_graph=graph)

do.description: Inject all dependencies through constructor. Example: def __init__(self, config_loader, domain_graph): self._loader = config_loader

example: # All dependencies visible in constructor signature

dont.description: Don't access globals, singletons, or create dependencies internally. Example: self._loader = ConfigLoader() (wrong - creates internally)

example: config = GlobalConfig.instance()  # WRONG - hidden global dependency
self._loader = ConfigLoader()  # WRONG - should be injected

guidance.description: Don't import and instantiate inside methods
example: from loader import Loader; loader = Loader()  # WRONG - inject via constructor
